items.information: * Make sure to be available at the venue at least 30 minutes before your event starts. Late entries won't be allowed to participate. * Participants must bring their own cubes and puzzles. * Attend the tutorial session if you're new to WCA competitions or unfamiliar with its rules. * Bring a government ID card for verification if it's your first time participating in a WCA competition. * Participants are expected to volunteer and will be assigned with roles as judges, scramblers, or runners, with the exception of newcomers. * Addition of any New Round on spot will be done only under the discretion of the Delegate with consultation of Organising team. **Non-Veg Food is strictly prohibited in the Venue Premises.**

items.information: Dieser Wettkampf ist eine Partner-Competition von Franconia Christmas B 2024. items.information: ### On the spot registration is open for 2x2x2, 3x3x3, Pyraminx, and Skewb events only. Kejuaraan Speedcubing Nasional untuk Indonesia pada tahun 2024. Peserta dari segala usia dan kewarganegaraan dipersilakan untuk mengikuti. Harap diperhatikan tentang limit dan cutoff untuk setiap event, karena lebih ketat daripada kompetisi biasanya. Akan ada **2 jenis pemenang** dalam kompetisi ini: **Kategori Terbuka** - 3 pemenang teratas kompetisi tanpa memandang kewarganegaraan **Kategori Indonesia** - 3 pemenang teratas yang mewakili Indonesia di setiap kategori Peserta atau pendamping harus setuju bahwa penyelenggara, NSA, dan WCA tidak bertanggung jawab atas cedera pribadi, atau kerusakan atau kehilangan barang pribadi anda yang diakibatkan oleh partisipasi Anda dalam acara ini. Untuk informasi lebih lanjut, silakan periksa **Persyaratan Pendaftaran.** Biaya pendaftaran termasuk, Sertifikat Partisipasi, Lanyard, dan Name Tag. Silahkan melakukan registrasi di website WCA dan konfirmasi di [form ini](https://forms.gle/h89T8gudSJRxWPaF9) *Harap perhatikan jadwal selama periode pendaftaran terbuka karena dapat berubah tergantung pada jumlah orang yang mendaftar untuk setiap acara.* --- ### Registrasi OTS dibuka hanya untuk cabang 2x2x2, 3x3x3, Pyraminx, dan Skewb. The National Speedcubing Championship for Indonesia in 2024. Competitiors of all ages and nationality are welcomed to join. Please notice the time limit and cutoff on each events, as they are stricter than regular competitions. There will be **2 types of winners** in this competition: **Open Category** - Top 3 winners of the competition regardless of nationality **Indonesian Category** - Top 3 winners representing the Indonesia in each category Competitor or guardian must agree that the organizers, NSA and WCA shall not be liable for any personal injury, property damage or loss resulting from your participation of this event. For more information, please check the **Registration Requirements.** Registration fee includes, Certificate of Participation, Lanyard and Name Tag. Please register in the WCA website and confirm your registration by filling out [this form](https://forms.gle/h89T8gudSJRxWPaF9) *Please keep an eye on our schedule during the open registration period as it may change depending on the number of people registering for each event.*
